authorInfo.bio: Pedro Calderón de la Barca (1600–1681) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "The Wonder-Working Magician" by Pedro Calderón de la Barca is a dramatic work that likely dates from the mid-17th century. The play unfolds in Antioch and centers around Cyprian, a scholar who grapples with complex themes of love and morality, as well as the influence of supernatural forces in human affairs.
